knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r, include =TRUE, echo=TRUE, message = FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(chromVAR)
  library(rtracklayer)
  library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
  library(motifmatchr)
  library(BiocParallel)
  library(JASPAR2020)
  library(TFBSTools)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(limma)
  library(openxlsx)
})
register(MulticoreParam(workers = 60))
```

```{r, include =TRUE, echo=TRUE, message = FALSE}
## ---- paths ----
bam_dir  <- "/pl/active/getahun_lab/Project_tbet_ATACseq/bam_files"
peak_dir <- "/pl/active/getahun_lab/Project_tbet_ATACseq/consensus_peaks"
meta_file <- "/pl/active/getahun_lab/Project_tbet_ATACseq/metadata.tsv"
union_bed <- file.path(peak_dir, "ALL8_union_peaks.bed")
out_path  <- "/pl/active/getahun_lab/Project_tbet_ATACseq/chromVAR_output"

stopifnot(dir.exists(bam_dir))
stopifnot(file.exists(union_bed))
stopifnot(file.exists(meta_file))
dir.create(out_path, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- 1) load union peaks + resize to 500 bp ----
peaks <- import(union_bed)
peaks <- resize(peaks, width = 500, fix = "center")
message("Union peak count: ", length(peaks))
```

```{r, include =TRUE, echo=TRUE, message = FALSE}
## ---- 2) collect BAMs ----
bam_files <- sort(list.files(bam_dir, pattern = "sorted\\.rmdup\\.qc\\.removebl\\.bam$", full.names = TRUE))
message("Found BAMs: ", length(bam_files))
stopifnot(length(bam_files) == 24)
## check indexes (.bam.bai)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(paste0(bam_files, ".bai"))))
```

```{r, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- 3) counts ----
counts <- getCounts(
  bam_files,
  peaks,
  paired = TRUE,
  format = "bam"
)
message("Counts object dim (peaks x samples): ", nrow(counts), " x ", ncol(counts))
```

```{r, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- 4) GC bias + filter peaks ----
counts <- addGCBias(counts, genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
counts <- filterPeaks(counts)
```

```{r, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- 5) motifs ----
opts   <- list(tax_group = "vertebrates", collection = "CORE")
motifs <- TFBSTools::getMatrixSet(JASPAR2020::JASPAR2020, opts)
motif_ix <- matchMotifs(motifs, counts, genome = BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
```

```{r, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- 6) deviations ----
dev <- computeDeviations(counts, annotations = motif_ix)
```

```{r, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- 7) save ----
saveRDS(counts, file = file.path(out_path, "chromVAR_counts_ALL24_unionPeaks_500bp.rds"))
saveRDS(dev,    file = file.path(out_path, "chromVAR_deviations_ALL24_unionPeaks_500bp.rds"))
message("Saved counts and deviations to: ", out_path)
```

```{r load_existing, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- Load previously saved objects (skip recomputation) ----
counts_rds <- file.path(out_path, "chromVAR_counts_ALL24_unionPeaks_500bp.rds")
dev_rds    <- file.path(out_path, "chromVAR_deviations_ALL24_unionPeaks_500bp.rds")

if (file.exists(counts_rds) && file.exists(dev_rds)) {
  message("Loading existing chromVAR objects...")
  counts <- readRDS(counts_rds)
  dev    <- readRDS(dev_rds)
  message("Counts dim: ", nrow(counts), " peaks x ", ncol(counts), " samples")
  message("Deviations dim: ", nrow(deviations(dev)), " motifs x ", ncol(deviations(dev)), " samples")
} else {
  stop("Saved chromVAR RDS files not found. Run chunks 1-7 first.")
}

tf_dev <- deviations(dev)
```

```{r convert_jaspar_names, echo=TRUE}
## ---- JASPAR ID -> TF name ----
opts   <- list(tax_group = "vertebrates", collection = "CORE")
motifs <- TFBSTools::getMatrixSet(JASPAR2020::JASPAR2020, opts)

id_to_name <- setNames(TFBSTools::name(motifs), TFBSTools::ID(motifs))
new_names <- id_to_name[rownames(tf_dev)]
new_names[is.na(new_names)] <- rownames(tf_dev)
rownames(tf_dev) <- make.unique(new_names)

head(rownames(tf_dev))
```

```{r load_metadata, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- metadata ----
metadata <- read.csv(meta_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample_id

metadata$genotype  <- factor(metadata$genotype)
metadata$condition <- factor(metadata$condition, levels = c("L", "LG", "LA21", "LA21G"))
metadata$replicate <- factor(metadata$replicate)
metadata$seq_batch <- factor(metadata$seq_batch)

## rownames to match chromVAR BAM basenames
meta_df <- metadata
rownames(meta_df) <- paste0(rownames(meta_df), ".sorted.rmdup.qc.removebl.bam")
```

```{r clean_sample_names, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- align tf_dev column names to metadata rownames ----
tf_samples_raw <- colnames(tf_dev)
tf_sample_id   <- sub("\\.sorted\\.rmdup\\.qc\\.removebl\\.bam$", "", basename(tf_samples_raw))
colnames(tf_dev) <- tf_sample_id

cat("tf_dev samples:", length(colnames(tf_dev)), "\n")
cat("metadata samples:", length(rownames(metadata)), "\n")
cat("Missing in metadata:", length(setdiff(colnames(tf_dev), rownames(metadata))), "\n")
cat("Missing in tf_dev:", length(setdiff(rownames(metadata), colnames(tf_dev))), "\n")
stopifnot(all(colnames(tf_dev) %in% rownames(metadata)))

meta <- metadata[colnames(tf_dev), , drop = FALSE]
```

```{r pca_raw, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- PCA (raw deviations) ----
pca_raw <- prcomp(t(tf_dev), scale. = TRUE)
pct_raw <- (pca_raw$sdev^2) / sum(pca_raw$sdev^2) * 100

df_pca <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(tf_dev),
  PC1       = pca_raw$x[, 1],
  PC2       = pca_raw$x[, 2],
  genotype  = meta$genotype,
  condition = meta$condition,
  batch     = meta$seq_batch
)

ggplot(df_pca, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition, shape = genotype, label = sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.8, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(
    title = "chromVAR PCA (raw z-scores)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pct_raw[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pct_raw[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r batch_correction, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- limma batch correction ----
samps    <- sub("\\.sorted\\.rmdup\\.qc\\.removebl\\.bam$", "", basename(colnames(assays(dev)$z)))
meta_use <- metadata[samps, , drop = FALSE]
colData(dev) <- S4Vectors::DataFrame(meta_use)

Z         <- assays(dev)$z
genotype  <- droplevels(factor(meta_use$genotype))
condition <- droplevels(factor(meta_use$condition))
batch     <- droplevels(factor(meta_use$seq_batch))

# batch correct preserving genotype + condition
design_bc <- model.matrix(~ genotype + condition)

if (nlevels(batch) > 1) {
  Z_bc <- removeBatchEffect(Z, batch = batch, design = design_bc)
} else {
  message("Only one batch; skipping batch correction.")
  Z_bc <- Z
}

## ---- PCA post batch correction ----
pca_bc  <- prcomp(t(Z_bc), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pct_bc  <- (pca_bc$sdev^2) / sum(pca_bc$sdev^2) * 100

df_bc <- data.frame(
  sample    = samps,
  PC1       = pca_bc$x[, 1],
  PC2       = pca_bc$x[, 2],
  genotype  = genotype,
  condition = condition,
  batch     = batch
)

pcs <- ggplot(df_bc, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition, shape = genotype, label = sample)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 2.8, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  labs(
    title = "chromVAR PCA (batch-corrected z-scores)",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(pct_bc[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(pct_bc[2], 1), "%)")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r heatmap, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- Heatmap: top variable TFs (batch-corrected) ----
mat <- Z_bc
id2tf <- setNames(TFBSTools::name(motifs), TFBSTools::ID(motifs))
rownames(mat) <- ifelse(rownames(mat) %in% names(id2tf), id2tf[rownames(mat)], rownames(mat))
rownames(mat) <- make.unique(rownames(mat))

ann_col <- data.frame(genotype = genotype, condition = condition, batch = batch)
rownames(ann_col) <- colnames(mat)

hmap <- pheatmap(
  mat,
  annotation_col = ann_col,
  cluster_rows   = TRUE,
  cluster_cols   = TRUE,
  show_rownames  = FALSE,
  show_colnames  = TRUE,
  fontsize_col   = 9,
  main           = "chromVAR all TFs (batch-corrected z-scores)"
)
```

```{r ko_vs_wt_barplots, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
make_delta <- function(cond) {
  idx_wt <- which(meta$condition == cond & meta$genotype == "WT")
  idx_ko <- which(meta$condition == cond & meta$genotype == "KO")
  mean_wt <- rowMeans(tf_dev[, idx_wt, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_ko <- rowMeans(tf_dev[, idx_ko, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    TF        = rownames(tf_dev),
    delta     = mean_ko - mean_wt,
    condition = cond,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

delta_list <- lapply(c("L", "LG", "LA21", "LA21G"), make_delta)
delta_all  <- do.call(rbind, delta_list)
delta_all$condition <- factor(delta_all$condition, levels = c("L", "LG", "LA21", "LA21G"))

topN <- 30
plots_bar <- lapply(c("L", "LG", "LA21", "LA21G"), function(cond) {
  df      <- delta_all[delta_all$condition == cond, ]
  df      <- df[order(df$delta, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  plot_df <- rbind(head(df, topN), tail(df, topN))
  plot_df$direction <- ifelse(plot_df$delta > 0, "Higher in KO", "Lower in KO")
  plot_df$TF <- factor(plot_df$TF, levels = plot_df$TF[order(plot_df$delta)])
  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = TF, y = delta, fill = direction)) +
    geom_col() + coord_flip() + theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    labs(title = paste0("KO vs WT: ", cond),
         x = "TF", y = "Δ chromVAR z-score (KO - WT)")
})

for (p in plots_bar) print(p)
```

```{r faceted_volcano, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- Faceted volcano: KO vs WT, all 4 conditions ----
make_volc <- function(cond) {
  idx_wt <- which(meta$condition == cond & meta$genotype == "WT")
  idx_ko <- which(meta$condition == cond & meta$genotype == "KO")
  mean_wt <- rowMeans(tf_dev[, idx_wt, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_ko <- rowMeans(tf_dev[, idx_ko, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  pvals   <- apply(tf_dev, 1, function(row) t.test(row[idx_ko], row[idx_wt])$p.value)
  data.frame(
    TF             = rownames(tf_dev),
    delta          = mean_ko - mean_wt,
    pval           = pvals,
    neg_log10_pval = -log10(pvals),
    comparison     = paste0("KO vs WT: ", cond),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

volc_all <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("L", "LG", "LA21", "LA21G"), make_volc))
volc_all$comparison <- factor(volc_all$comparison,
  levels = paste0("KO vs WT: ", c("L", "LG", "LA21", "LA21G")))

delta_cut <- 1
pval_cut  <- 0.05

volc_all$sig <- ifelse(
  abs(volc_all$delta) > delta_cut & volc_all$pval < pval_cut,
  ifelse(volc_all$delta > 0, "Up in KO", "Down in KO"), "NS"
)

p_volc <- ggplot(volc_all, aes(x = delta, y = neg_log10_pval)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sig), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up in KO" = "#D7191C", "Down in KO" = "#2C7BB6", "NS" = "grey80")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pval_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-delta_cut, delta_cut), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(volc_all, sig != "NS"),
    aes(label = TF, color = sig), size = 2.2,
    max.overlaps = 20, segment.size = 0.2, segment.alpha = 0.3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ comparison, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "Δ chromVAR z-score (KO - WT)",
    y     = expression(-log[10]~"(p-value)"),
    color = NULL
  )

p_volc
ggsave(file.path(out_path, "volcano_faceted_KOvsWT_4conditions.pdf"), p_volc, width = 20, height = 8)
```

```{r concordance, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, message=FALSE}
## ---- Concordance: KO vs WT in LA21 (x) vs KO vs WT in LA21g (y) ----
make_conc <- function(cond) {
  idx_wt  <- which(meta$condition == cond & meta$genotype == "WT")
  idx_ko  <- which(meta$condition == cond & meta$genotype == "KO")
  mean_wt <- rowMeans(tf_dev[, idx_wt, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_ko <- rowMeans(tf_dev[, idx_ko, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  pvals   <- apply(tf_dev, 1, function(row) t.test(row[idx_ko], row[idx_wt])$p.value)
  list(delta = mean_ko - mean_wt, pval = pvals)
}

res_L     <- make_conc("L")
res_Lg    <- make_conc("LG")
res_LA21  <- make_conc("LA21")
res_LA21g <- make_conc("LA21G")

conc_df <- data.frame(
  TF          = rownames(tf_dev),
  delta_L     = res_L$delta,
  delta_Lg    = res_Lg$delta,
  delta_LA21  = res_LA21$delta,
  delta_LA21g = res_LA21g$delta,
  pval_L      = res_L$pval,
  pval_Lg     = res_Lg$pval,
  pval_LA21   = res_LA21$pval,
  pval_LA21g  = res_LA21g$pval,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

## LA21 vs LA21g concordance
conc_df$quad <- with(conc_df, ifelse(
  pval_LA21 < 0.05 & pval_LA21g < 0.05, "Both significant",
  ifelse(pval_LA21  < 0.05, "LA21 only",
  ifelse(pval_LA21g < 0.05, "LA21g only", "Neither"))
))

p_conc <- ggplot(conc_df, aes(x = delta_LA21, y = delta_LA21g)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey60") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(color = quad), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Both significant" = "#5778A4",
                                "LA21 only"        = "#6A9F58",
                                "LA21g only"       = "#E49444",
                                "Neither"          = "#D4D4D4")) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(conc_df, quad != "Neither"),
    aes(label = TF, color = quad), size = 2.5,
    max.overlaps = 25, min.segment.length = 0,
    segment.size = 0.2, segment.alpha = 0.4,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  labs(
    title = "Concordance: KO vs WT (LA21 vs LA21g)",
    x     = "Δz KO vs WT in LA21",
    y     = "Δz KO vs WT in LA21g",
    color = NULL
  )

p_conc
ggsave(file.path(out_path, "concordance_LA21_vs_LA21g_KOvsWT.pdf"), p_conc, width = 10, height = 9)
```

## ---- Prism concordance format ----
make_prism_wide <- function(df, x_col, y_col, sig_col, cats, label_col = "TF") {
  n <- nrow(df)
  out <- data.frame(TF = df[[label_col]], X = df[[x_col]])
  for (cat in cats) {
    col <- rep(NA_real_, n)
    col[df[[sig_col]] == cat] <- df[[y_col]][df[[sig_col]] == cat]
    out[[cat]] <- col
  }
  out
}

## L vs LG
prism_LvsLG <- make_prism_wide(
  conc_LvsLG, "delta_L", "delta_LG", "quad",
  cats = c("Both significant", "L only", "LG only", "Neither")
)
write.csv(prism_LvsLG,
          file = file.path(out_path, "prism_concordance_L_vs_LG.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, na = "")

## LA21 vs LA21G
prism_LA21 <- make_prism_wide(
  conc_df, "delta_LA21", "delta_LA21g", "quad",
  cats = c("Both significant", "LA21 only", "LA21G only", "Neither")
)
write.csv(prism_LA21,
          file = file.path(out_path, "prism_concordance_LA21_vs_LA21G.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, na = "")

message("Prism CSVs saved to: ", out_path)
